flow-definition.description: Attendance T13 pipeline for the dedicated local kind cluster. The job reads Jenkinsfile from the local bare repository mounted at /workspace.git; parameters may be overridden per build.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REGISTRY_IMAGE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Registry repository for this test image.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REGISTRY_CREDENTIALS_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Jenkins username/password credential for the registry.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TEST_NAMESPACE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Existing isolated test namespace with persistent storage.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TEST_BASE_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: URL reachable by the Jenkins agent for Selenium.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TEST_CREDENTIALS_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Jenkins username/password credential for the isolated test account.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: KIND_NODE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional local kind node container name used to import the built image.
